detail.longDescription: Proof of concept for one of those "a calculator for everything" sites, but with custom a multistep calculator builder, graph plotting, and a somewhat hacky algorithm for "enter any 2 of 3" type calculators. I started working on this on a whim after noticing the lack of any fast easy way to do a general ballpark inrush transient simulation. It's also installable as a PWA, and it supports adding and editing custom values in the reference tables. Still very much alpha, I think the capacitor DC bias model and the inrush current simulations may need some work to improve the accuracy. The data tables all need to be double checked, and there's some fairly obvious features that aren't there yet.
